title: A Light for Saltmarrow
description: The Gull's Beacon on the headland has been dark since the Snuffing. Mara thinks the Keeper hiding in the village knows how to relight it.

stages.text: Find Brother Aldous in Saltmarrow and ask him about the beacon.
Cross the greyed net-lofts and reach the Gull's Beacon on the headland.
The Gull's Beacon must be fed a Remnant. Whatever burns, Saltmarrow forgets for good. Decide what it will be, then return to the beacon.
